Lynch Lecturer of Business Administration Lecturer of Business Administration Anita Lynch is a Lecturer in the Technology and Operations Management Unit at Harvard Business School. She teaches the required MBA course Data Science and Artificial Intelligence for Leaders, which examines how data, AI, and emerging technologies reshape business strategy, organizational design, corporate governance and society.
